crossRefs.note: He who guards his mouth guards his soul. One who opens wide his lips comes to ruin.
A righteous man hates lies, but a wicked man brings shame and disgrace.
The fear of man proves to be a snare, but whoever puts his trust in Yahweh is kept safe.
Therefore putting away falsehood, speak truth each one with his neighbor. For we are members of one another.

translations.web: He said to her, “If they only bind me with new ropes with which no work has been done, then shall I become weak, and be as another man.”
translations.bsb: He replied, “If they tie me up with new ropes that have never been used, I will become as weak as any other man.”
translations.kjv: And he said unto her, If they bind me fast with new ropes that never were occupied, then shall I be weak, and be as another man.
translations.asv: And he said unto her, If they only bind me with new ropes wherewith no work hath been done, then shall I become weak, and be as another man.
